summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Compare dropdown and 3 head-to-head comparison pages on the live preview. Verified functional behavior of the desktop hover dropdown, mobile menu Compare section, all 3 comparison pages render fully, CTA navigates to /contact, and zero React console errors (no #418/#423) on Home, FAQ, all 3 comparison pages, and /contact.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx darkHeroPages list only includes /travel-incentives-vs-discounting explicitly, but the ternary onDarkHero also uses pathname.startsWith('/travel-incentives-vs-') which correctly covers the other two — the hardcoded entry is redundant but harmless.

Comparison.jsx uses ` ${altLabel}` (template literal wrapping a leading space) and `Travel incentives ${c.label}` in Header — these are single JSX expressions (not mixed JSX text nodes), which is why hydration is clean. Good pattern; keep it consistent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://bestbuy-incentives.preview.emergentagent.com. Compare dropdown is hover-only on desktop (group-hover), so playwright must .hover() the [data-testid=nav-compare-trigger] before links become visible, or navigate directly to the URLs. Verified data-testids: nav-compare-trigger, nav-compare-{discounting|gift-cards|cash-rebates}, nav-mobile-toggle, nav-mobile-compare, nav-mobile-compare-{slug}, comparison-page, compare-row-{i} (7 rows each), compare-faq-{i} (3 FAQs each), comparison-cta (links to /contact). All 3 comparison pages have the exact expected structure: dark hero H1 'Travel incentives vs. <word>', 3-col table, 2-card math section, FAQ section, yellow CTA.
